name: rq2-eval-tradeoff-1
estimator: Unweighted mean of within-family mean paired differences. A case scores 1 when every critical fact is present. The paired difference is heuristic minus direct. Cases in a family are averaged first. The eight family means then receive equal weight.

interval.method: Percentile bootstrap of the eight generation-family means, with replacement, 2000 resamples, seed 20261106. Sorted ascending, lower index int(0.025*2000)-1 and upper index int(0.975*2000)-1.

limitations: Eight families are the independent units. Forty-eight cases are not forty-eight families.
The percentile interval has only the resolution of eight clusters.
One generation per case. A repeated generation would not add a family.
The heuristic was chosen from earlier development work, before this file was scored.
The estimate belongs to llama3.2 at temperature 0 and max_tokens 64, with the frozen routes.
An interval that covers zero is not a finding of no loss, and no margin is applied.
Message counts and character counts are not token counts.
The grid omits start-loose and distributed-loose.
secondary: chronological_minus_direct on the same answer indicator
melis_none_minus_direct on the same answer indicator
critical fact retained in the forwarded context
reduction of forwarded messages and of characters for the compacting arms
duration_plan_basis: development pilot, 420 seconds for 96 calls, scaled to 192 calls
